annotations.title: Read how each page of the book looks, part by part.

description: Reads the book’s style file: every part of a person’s page, with its size, place, typeface, colour and alignment, what each part means, the limits the print rules keep, and the people who have pages. Use it before set_style, and whenever the person asks how the pages look or what can change.

person.description: A name as it prints on their pages, to read that person’s pages as they print.
